title: Identification of sepsis-associated encephalopathy biomarkers through machine learning and bioinformatics approaches.
summary: Full primary article confirms transcriptomic ML identified 18 SAE candidate biomarkers, with a separate dataset and BV2-cell qPCR evidence; approve as candidate biology, not clinical biomarkers.
ai_technology: PMC Methods: three GEO datasets, WGCNA and Elastic Net/LASSO/RF/XGBoost; Results: 18 selected biomarkers, external GEO validation and in-vitro qPCR differential expression.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Full primary article confirms transcriptomic ML identified 18 SAE candidate biomarkers, with a separate dataset and BV2-cell qPCR evidence; approve as candidate biology, not clinical biomarkers.
evidence.unknown: Candidate biomarkers and BV2-cell qPCR do not establish clinical diagnostic performance or causal disease mechanisms.
